observation.description: The frozen run-capsule.v1 schema requires arm.contract ∈ {a1…a6} with additionalProperties:false, but LLP 0137's own diary/evidence protocol requires a capsule for the G1 qualification arm, which implements no contract. This capsule was forced to record a placeholder contract ('a2') with armKind 'untimed-extension' and an environment.role disclaimer — a freeze artifact defect in the G0 evidence schemas, not a product defect.

competitorOutcome.description: Not a competitor-comparable product fact; internal evidence-protocol gap.

mustNotRegress: The freeze-boundary rule that outcome-affecting protocol changes need a dated prospective amendment and re-freeze; retained capsules are never rewritten.
smallestCoherentFix: Prospective G0 amendment: allow a contract-free qualification arm (add 'none'/'g1' to the contract enum or a dedicated armKind that drops the contract requirement), then re-freeze per demos/improvement-sweep/README.md's amendment rules.
acceptanceWitness: A future qualification capsule validates against the amended schema without a placeholder contract, and verify-freeze passes on the amended tree.
